Title: Sign up with valid details
Steps:
1. Open /
2. Click 'Create account'
3. Enter name 'Asha', a new email and an 8+ character password
4. Submit
Expected result: Account is created and the user is redirected to /profile.html?welcome=1 with the 'Welcome to Planly!' banner.
Actual result: landed on /profile.html?welcome=1; welcome banner: true

Title: Sign up with an email that already exists
Steps: 1. Create account with the existing email
Expected result: Error 'An account with this email already exists.' is shown. No second account is created.
Actual result: 409 "An account with this email already exists."

Title: Sign up with an invalid email
Steps: 1. Create account with email 'asha@'
Expected result: Error 'Enter a valid email address.' is shown.
Actual result: 400 "Enter a valid email address."

Title: Password length boundary (7 vs 8 characters)
Steps:
1. Create account with a 7-character password
2. Retry with exactly 8 characters
Expected result: 7 characters: 'Password must be at least 8 characters.' 8 characters: account is created.
Actual result: 7 chars: 400 "Password must be at least 8 characters."; 8 chars: 201

Title: Log in with a wrong password or unknown email
Steps:
1. Log in with the right email and wrong password
2. Log in with an email that doesn't exist
Expected result: Both show the same message 'Email or password is incorrect.' (doesn't reveal which emails exist).
Actual result: wrong pw: 401 "Email or password is incorrect."; unknown: 401 "Email or password is incorrect."

Title: Protected pages while signed out
Steps:
1. Open /app.html, /plans.html and /profile.html directly
2. Call GET /api/conversations
Expected result: Each page redirects to the login page. The API returns 401 'Not signed in'.
Actual result: /app.html → /; /plans.html → /; /profile.html → /; API 401 "Not signed in"

Title: Logout asks for confirmation
Steps:
1. Click the logout icon
2. Click 'Stay signed in'
3. Click logout again and press Esc
4. Click logout again and click 'Log out'
Expected result: Dialog 'Log out of Planly?' appears each time. Stay signed in and Esc keep the session. 'Log out' returns to the login page and /api/auth/me returns 401.
Actual result: dialog "Log out of Planly?"; after cancel 200; after Esc 200; after logout → /, /me 401

Title: New user must complete onboarding first
Steps: 1. Open /app.html
Expected result: Redirected to /profile.html?welcome=1. After saving preferences the user lands in the chat.
Actual result: redirected to /profile.html?welcome=1; after saving → /app.html

Title: Save a complete profile
Steps:
1. Fill interests, hobbies, dislikes, social style, group size, activity level, budget, currency, distance and home city
2. Click 'Save preferences'
3. Reload the page
Expected result: 'Preferences saved.' toast. After reload every field shows the saved value, and 'You told us' lists each like and dislike.
Actual result: fields saved: true; 'You told us' has 7 items (crowded places, nightclubs, board games, hiking, cafés, live music…); location "Delhi, National Capital Territory of Delhi, India"

Title: Interest chips: Enter, comma and duplicates
Steps:
1. Type 'Hiking' + Enter
2. Type 'hiking, Photography,' in one go
3. Click × on a chip
Expected result: Comma and Enter both create chips. 'hiking' is not added twice (case-insensitive). × removes the chip.
Actual result: chips after add: [photography, live music, cafés, Hiking, Pottery]; after ×: [photography, live music, cafés, Hiking]

Title: Minimum budget higher than maximum
Steps:
1. Set minimum 3000 and maximum 1000
2. Save
Expected result: Error 'Minimum budget is higher than maximum.' Profile is not saved.
Actual result: 400 "Minimum budget is higher than maximum."

Title: Negative budget value
Steps:
1. Set minimum budget to -500 via the API or devtools
2. Save
Expected result: Value is rejected or stored as 0. A negative budget is never saved.
Notes: Known gap: the server currently accepts negative numbers.
Actual result: stored null

Title: Travel distance limits
Steps:
1. Save distance 0
2. Save distance 1000
Expected result: Stored as 1 km and 500 km respectively (clamped to 1–500).

Title: Unknown home city
Steps:
1. Enter home city 'Xyzqwerty'
2. Save
Expected result: Error 'Couldn't find "Xyzqwerty". Try a city name.' Previous location is kept.
Actual result: 400 "Couldn't find "Xyzqwerty". Try a city name."; location still "Delhi, National Capital Territory of Delhi, India"

Title: Ambiguous city name
Steps:
1. Enter home city 'Hyderabad'
2. Save
Expected result: City is saved with its full resolved name (e.g. 'Hyderabad, Telangana, India') so the user can see which one was picked.
Actual result: saved as "Hyderabad, Telangana, India"

Title: Browser location permission denied
Steps:
1. Click 'Use current' on the profile page
2. Click the 📍 button in the chat
Expected result: Toast 'Location permission was denied.' Nothing changes, and the typed home city is still used.
Actual result: toast "Location permission was denied."; city field "Delhi, National Capital Territory of Delhi, India"

Title: No location at all
Steps: 1. Ask 'What can I do this weekend?'
Expected result: Planly asks which city or area to search, or explains it needs a location. It doesn't guess a city or invent events.
Actual result: No recommendations; reply asks for a city/location.

Title: Profile changes apply to the next request
Steps:
1. Add interest 'pottery' and save
2. Ask 'Ideas for this weekend?'
Expected result: At least one recommendation or the reply reflects pottery or ceramics, or the reply says none were found this weekend.
Actual result: Pottery/ceramics mentioned in recommendations or reply.

Title: Dislikes are respected
Steps: 1. Ask 'Fun night out tonight?'
Expected result: No nightclub or club-night recommendations. Options are live music, cafés or similar.
Actual result: 5 options for tonight (Piano Man live music, board games, karaoke). No nightclubs; all within Delhi.

Title: Removing a profile item from 'What Planly knows'
Steps:
1. Click the trash icon next to 'You enjoy hiking'
2. Click 'Save preferences'
3. Reload
Expected result: 'hiking' disappears from the knowledge panel and from the Hobbies chips, and does not come back after saving.
Actual result: hobbies after delete+save: [board games]; 'hiking' in knowledge panel: false

Title: Weekend suggestions (UC-01)
Steps: 1. Ask 'What should I do this weekend?'
Expected result: Status shows 'Searching the web…'. The reply streams in. 3–5 real options dated this Saturday/Sunday, each with a personal reason, source and Details link.
Actual result: 5 options, all on Saturday or Sunday, within budget and distance; reply flags rain on Sunday morning and suggests starting indoors.

Title: Weekend itinerary
Steps: 1. Click 'Plan my weekend'
Expected result: A plan appears in the plan panel: items ordered by day and time, realistic times, meal breaks, each activity with venue, price and link. 'Save plan' button shown.
Actual result: 8 items over 2026-10-10, 2026-10-11, ordered, with breaks.

Title: Something to do tonight (UC-02)
Steps: 1. Ask 'I'm bored. Give me something to do tonight.'
Expected result: Only options happening or open today/tonight. Event dates equal today's date.
Actual result: 5 places open today (board game cafés, Cha Bar). Run at 03:45, so 'tonight' was the coming evening.

Title: Tonight request late at night
Steps: 1. Ask 'Something to do tonight?'
Expected result: Only late-open options, or an honest 'not much left tonight' with ideas for tomorrow. Nothing that has already ended.
Actual result: Tested in the Azores at 23:00 local time (the app now gets the user's time zone): it noted board game cafés had closed at 22:00 and suggested late-friendly options (self-guided city game, night photo walk, café).

Title: Meet new people (UC-03)
Steps: 1. Ask 'I want to meet new people this weekend.'
Expected result: Meetups, workshops, classes, group sports or community events are prioritised. Most cards show the 'Meet people' tag.
Actual result: 4/5 tagged 'Meet people'

Title: Socialise without clubbing
Steps: 1. Ask 'I want to socialise but don't want to go clubbing.'
Expected result: Social options with no nightclubs or club nights.
Actual result: 2 social options (photography exhibition, board game meet-up), no clubbing. Fewer than the usual 3–5.

Title: Holiday planning (UC-04)
Steps: 1. Ask 'I have four days off next month. Where should I go?'
Expected result: Destination ideas within budget and travel preferences, from real sources. No flight or hotel booking is attempted.
Notes: Full holiday planning is Phase 2 in the PRD.
Actual result: Suggested real getaways (Rishikesh + Mussoorie, Bir Billing, Chopta & Tungnath, Kasol, Jaipur + Pushkar, Lansdowne). No booking attempted.

Expected result: The museum item is removed. All other items stay the same (titles, times, links).

Title: Swap one item for something cheaper
Preconditions: A plan with an evening concert exists.
Steps: 1. Say 'Swap the evening concert for something cheaper.'
Expected result: The concert is replaced with a real, cheaper option at a similar time. Other items are unchanged.
Actual result: Swapped the ₹300+ item for a free festival; the other 4 items were kept exactly.

Title: Replace button on a plan item
Steps: 1. Click the ↻ Replace icon on one plan item
Expected result: A chat message 'Replace "<title>" in my plan with something else.' is sent and the plan updates with a different real option in that slot.
Actual result: Replaced only the hike (with the Asola Bhatti walk, same 13:30 slot); everything else unchanged.

Title: Edit request when no plan exists
Steps: 1. Say 'Remove the museum.'
Expected result: Reply explains there's no current plan and offers to make one. No error.
Actual result: No plan created; reply explains there is no plan.

Title: Specific future date
Steps: 1. Ask 'What's on next Sunday?'
Expected result: Events are dated next Sunday (not this Sunday). The reply names the date.
Actual result: Took "next Sunday" as Sunday 11 Oct and stated the date explicitly; all options dated that day.

Title: Budget given in the message
Steps: 1. Ask 'Something this Saturday under ₹500.'
Expected result: Every option is free or costs at most ₹500. The profile budget is not changed.
Actual result: 4 options, all ≤ ₹500 and on Saturday. Profile budget unchanged.

Title: Different city in the message
Steps: 1. Ask 'Things to do in Mumbai this weekend?'
Expected result: Results are in Mumbai. The home city in the profile stays Delhi.
Actual result: 5 recs, all in Mumbai; home city still Delhi.

Title: Very specific activity
Steps: 1. Ask 'Any pottery workshops this month?'
Expected result: Only pottery or ceramics options, or an honest 'none found'. No unrelated padding.
Actual result: 4 recs, all pottery/ceramics.

Title: Weather-aware suggestions
Preconditions: Forecast shows rain for the weekend.
Steps: 1. Ask 'Outdoor ideas for this weekend?'
Expected result: Reply mentions the rain and suggests indoor or covered alternatives, or plans outdoor items for the drier day.
Actual result: Reply flags Sunday-morning rain and recommends Saturday/untimed outdoor options; an outdoor item the model had scheduled during the rain was removed ("Left out 1 suggestion outdoors during the rain or storms forecast").

Title: Each recommendation explains why
Steps:
1. Ask for weekend ideas
2. Read every card
Expected result: Every card has a reason that refers to this user (interests, social preference, budget, distance or weather), not a generic description.
Actual result: Reasons refer to this user's interests (photography, board games, meeting people, small groups).

Title: Something different from usual (novelty)
Preconditions: Standard user who often gets café suggestions.
Steps: 1. Ask 'Something different from what I usually do.'
Expected result: Options go beyond the usual cafés, e.g. workshops, tastings or new activity types, while still fitting the profile.
Actual result: 3 recs, 0 café/food; categories: arts, outdoors, games

Title: Follow-up keeps context
Preconditions: Planly just answered 'weekend ideas in Delhi'.
Steps: 1. Say 'Make it cheaper.'
Expected result: Same dates and city, cheaper options. Planly doesn't ask again what or when.
Actual result: avg price before ₹220 → after ₹117; dates stayed in weekend.

Title: 'I'm bored'
Steps: 1. Send 'I'm bored'
Expected result: Assumes today or soon in the home city and gives real options that fit the profile. Quick replies offer ways to narrow down (e.g. tonight, this weekend, social).
Actual result: 5 options for today (board games, photo walks, live music) with quick replies to narrow down.

Title: 'idk'
Steps: 1. Send 'idk'
Expected result: Friendly reply that either suggests a few profile-based ideas or asks one simple question (when? what mood?). No error, no empty bubble.
Actual result: Friendly reply with 5 options for today (meetup, open mic, art show, board games, jazz).

Title: 'hmm'
Steps: 1. Send 'hmm'
Expected result: Short helpful reply inviting the user to say what they're in the mood for, with quick replies. No invented events.
Actual result: Gave 5 options for today and offered a full plan. Helpful, though more than a short invitation.

Title: 'Anything nearby?'
Steps: 1. Send 'anything nearby?'
Expected result: Options close to the home city or shared location, for today or soon, with distances or areas mentioned.
Actual result: "Nearby" now returns only central Delhi places (Connaught Place, Chanakyapuri, Khan Market, Malviya Nagar).

Title: 'cheap stuff'
PRD reference: §3 'I don't want to spend too much'
Steps: 1. Send 'cheap stuff'
Expected result: Free or low-cost options near the bottom of the budget range, with prices shown.
Actual result: 4 low-cost options (₹149–199 jam night, ₹199 board games, free photo walk).

Title: 'this weekend maybe'
Steps: 1. Send 'this weekend maybe'
Expected result: Treated as a weekend request: options for this Saturday/Sunday based on the profile.
Actual result: Treated as this weekend: Saturday events and places only, weather noted.

Title: 'with friends'
Steps: 1. Send 'with friends'
Expected result: Group-friendly options (board game cafés, group activities, live music), possibly asking when. Prices shown per person.
Actual result: 5 group-friendly picks (board game cafés, photography exhibition), prices shown.

Title: 'outside'
Steps: 1. Send 'outside'
Expected result: Outdoor options (walks, parks, hikes, outdoor events) with weather considered.
Actual result: All 5 options are outdoors (nature walks, hike, Deer Park, terrace music); Sunday-morning rain flagged.

Title: 'tomorrow'
Steps: 1. Send 'tomorrow'
Expected result: Options dated tomorrow. The reply names the day.
Actual result: All options dated tomorrow (Fri 9 Oct), stated in the reply; no nightlife.

Title: Single word 'plan'
Steps: 1. Send 'plan'
Expected result: Either builds a plan for the nearest sensible time (e.g. this weekend) and says so, or asks which day. No error.
Actual result: Built a plan for today (photo walk, dinner, live acoustic set, board games) and said it's for today.

Title: 'Surprise me'
Steps: 1. Click 'Surprise me'
Expected result: Real options that are a bit outside the usual interests but don't violate dislikes or budget.
Actual result: Genuinely different picks (cinema heritage walk, gaming café, nature walk); nothing over budget.

Title: 'the usual' with no history
Preconditions: New user, no previous chats or ratings.
Steps: 1. Send 'the usual'
Expected result: Explains there's no history yet and suggests options based on the profile's interests.
Actual result: Starts with "I don't have a usual saved for you yet", then suggests options from the profile.

Title: 'same as last time' in a new chat
Preconditions: User saved a plan in an earlier chat. Open a new chat.
Steps: 1. Send 'same as last time'
Expected result: Planly refers to the earlier saved plan or asks which one, rather than guessing.
Notes: Known gap: previous plans are not passed to the LLM, only memories and the current chat.
Actual result: Reply referred to the earlier saved plan.

Title: 'not that' as the first message
Steps: 1. Send 'not that'
Expected result: Asks what the user means or what they'd like instead. No crash and no exclusion of a random term.
Actual result: Asked what to avoid or change, with quick replies. No exclusion added.

Title: Greeting only: 'hi'
Steps: 1. Send 'hi'
Expected result: Friendly greeting inviting a request, optionally with quick replies. No recommendation cards needed.
Actual result: Greeted and offered 4 options for today, with quick replies.

Title: Typos and text-speak
Steps: 1. Send 'wat 2 do 2nite, cheap pls'
Expected result: Understood as cheap options for tonight. Results match that.
Actual result: Understood as cheap things tonight: 4 low-cost board game cafés.

Title: Hinglish message
Steps: 1. Send 'kal kuch fun karna hai, budget kam hai'
Expected result: Understood as 'something fun tomorrow, low budget'. Reply gives low-cost options for tomorrow.

Title: Over-constrained request
Steps: 1. Send 'free, indoors, tonight, within 1 km, no other people'
Expected result: If nothing real fits, says so honestly and suggests which constraint to relax. No invented venues.
Actual result: Said honestly nothing fully matches; offered 2 quiet cafés and suggested relaxing constraints. Nothing invented.

Title: 'what should I do?' with no time or place
Steps: 1. Send 'what should I do?'
Expected result: Uses the home city and a sensible near-term window, states that assumption, and gives real options plus quick replies to change it.
Actual result: Options for today in Delhi based on the profile, with quick replies to change time or type.

Title: Emoji-only message
Expected result: Interpreted as music + café ideas, or a friendly question back. No error.
Actual result: Read as music + coffee: music café, live qawwali tonight, photography exhibition.

2. Open a new chat B and ask for outdoor ideas
Expected result: Chat A: no trekking or hikes. Profile still lists hiking. Chat B: hikes can be suggested again.

Steps:
